purpose: decide in advance how to undo a release and prove the undo works
entry_criteria: Release scope and deployment method are known
Data and schema changes in the release are identified
procedure: For each component, state the rollback action and its time limit.
Mark changes that cannot be rolled back (data migrations, external side effects) and define a forward-fix instead.
Define the trigger conditions and who decides.
Test the rollback in a non-production environment and record the time taken.
Confirm the previous version, config and secrets are still available.
Add the plan to the readiness record.
acceptance_criteria: Every component has a rollback or forward-fix
Rollback test succeeded and time is recorded
Triggers and decision owner are named
validation_method: Rollback rehearsal in a non-production environment.

validation.command: kubectl rollout undo deployment/app && kubectl rollout status deployment/app   # example rehearsal in staging

validation.check: confirm the previous artifact digest is still pullable

failure_modes.detection: Old version fails on new schema
failure_modes.response: Use expand-then-contract or define a forward-fix

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Rollback of the service takes four minutes in staging. The additive schema change is left in place because the old version ignores the new column.
